calls.title: Backspace on the PROJECT chip takes the project away
calls.chose: With nothing typed, Backspace selects none
calls.because: One key to a projectless agent from wherever the composer opened.

calls.title: Secondary text on the new surfaces uses the skin's inks
calls.chose: ink_faint, ink_dim, edge_rest and rule instead of the palette's raw faint
calls.because: The hacker design's faint is near black; the side panel already used the inks and stayed readable.

calls.title: The add button beside PROJECT is drawn as a chip
calls.chose: sk.chip with the skin's control word, not a bezel button
calls.because: In Parker's own skin chips have no border and buttons do, so it looked heavier than its row.

calls.title: A projectless agent works in its own folder under ~/.scratch
calls.chose: A new folder per agent under ~/.scratch, named by date and first words
calls.because: T3 does this; the home folder made ~ the agent's project; TD's data folder is wiped by an uninstall.

calls.title: The inbox face's + NEW becomes the projects face's +
calls.chose: A bare + with a tooltip, where the projects face's + sits
calls.because: + NEW ran under the collapse arrow in chalk, and in Spanish, French and Russian in every skin.
calls.undo: Put the label back; the faces still truncate.

calls.title: Back from a clone field opened on the machines returns to them
calls.chose: Closing the field goes to where it was opened: the machines, or the folder list
calls.because: Back landed on a folder list the person had never seen, so it took two Backs to return.
passed_over: Keep Back on the folder list, so the parent folder can be changed

calls.title: Both lists keep their full height while they narrow
calls.chose: Blank rows hold the project list at eight and the folder list at ten
calls.because: Both cards are centred, so a shrinking list moved the sentence box while typing and moved rows under the pointer.
passed_over: Anchor the cards near the top, like a command palette

calls.title: The PROJECT chip says just none
calls.chose: A short word on the chip; the list row keeps the full wording
calls.because: The full wording wrapped REACH onto a second line at the composer's width.
calls.undo: Show project_none on the chip again.

calls.title: The composer's resting chips use the body's dim ink
calls.chose: ink_dim at rest unless the skin is paper, for the composer's chips only
calls.because: The clean design drew them in Faint, below the tabs' 3:1 floor, so they vanished at rest.
passed_over: Change Skin::chip for every chip in the app
calls.undo: Use sk.chip again in the composer.

calls.title: Failures in the T3 dialogs wear the skin's danger ink
calls.chose: Danger ink for failures, accent kept for guidance, as the side panel does
calls.because: The relate dialog's refusal was drawn in the accent, which reads as success in a green design.
passed_over: The warn ink for every note
calls.undo: Draw the notes in th.accent again.

calls.title: The side panel does not take the keyboard under a card
calls.chose: A press on the panel leaves the keys with the composer or relate dialog
calls.because: The card takes every key first, so the lit panel promised typing it never got.
passed_over: Put the card away on a press, which would kill a clone in progress
